sample_unit: ChatGPT-generated decision aid tools (one per question)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease) of ChatGPT-generated decision aids
links.effect: The reading level required to read the decision aid tools was high overall, despite high patient and physician understandability ratings.
links.quote: Accuracy was <4 (unfavorable) on 2 of the decision aid tools, and the reading level required to read them was high overall.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient decision aids relative to appropriate level
links.effect: Reading level required was high overall; all tools could benefit from improved readability.
links.quote: Accuracy was <4 (unfavorable) on 2 of the decision aid tools, and the reading level required to read them was high overall.

links.outcome: Physician-rated accuracy of ChatGPT decision aids on 5-point Likert scale
links.effect: Accuracy was <4 (unfavorable) on 2 of 6 decision aid tools; approximately 30% of topics require accuracy improvements.
links.quote: However, approximately 30% of the topics require improvements to accuracy, while all tools could benefit from improved reliability and readability.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-generated patient decision aid tools evaluated by patients and physicians for understandability, reliability, and readability, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
